notes.text: Sun 1 Nov (All Saints' Day) and Mon 2 Nov (All Souls' Day) are public holidays. Cemeteries glow with candles in the evenings, Rasos and Antakalnis in Vilnius best of all. Expect traffic near cemeteries and some places closed.

No guided nature walks are listed this week at Kernavė, in Neris Regional Park or in Vilnius's parks. For a self-guided outing, try the easy 5.5 km Sapieginė nature trail in Verkiai Regional Park, or see the Lumina light park in the VU Botanical Garden after dark.
